title: Navy Floral Hand Block Print Cotton Maxi Dress
description:
A breezy navy blue maxi dress in soft cotton, hand block printed with white and sky-blue florals in Jaipur.

• Round neck with a tie-up keyhole and tassels at the back
• Fitted bodice that opens into a full, tiered flare – made for twirling
• Sleeveless and light, perfect for summer days, holidays and brunch
• Every piece is printed by hand, so tiny variations make each one unique

Care: gentle hand wash in cold water, dry in shade.
